result.title: Saliency-Guided Replay for Continual Learning in Deep Spiking Neural Networks
result.comment: Streaming Continual Learning Workshop. In post-proceeding of International Workshops of ECML PKDD 2026
result.summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are promising for energy-efficient neuromorphic computing, but they still suffer from catastrophic forgetting when learning tasks sequentially. This work investigates the integration of Experience Packing and Replay (EPR) as a memory-efficient continual learning strategy for deep SNNs under low-latency constraints. The proposed framework combines Batch Normalization Through Time stabilized VGG9 SNNs with Spike Activation Maps (SAM), which provide forward-only explanations based on spike activity. These explanations are temporally aggregated into spatial attention maps and used to select the most informative image patches for replay, instead of storing full images. Experiments on Split CIFAR10 and Split CIFAR100 show that SAM-guided EPR improves the accuracy-memory trade-off under tight memory budgets, and remains competitive while requiring substantially less storage.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究低延迟约束下深层脉冲神经网络（SNN）的持续学习，用 Batch Normalization Through Time 稳定的 VGG9 结合脉冲激活图（SAM）生成空间注意力图，据此挑选信息量高的图像块进行回放以缓解灾难性遗忘，在 Split CIFAR10/100 上验证精度与存储的权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用显著性/注意力图筛选值得保留的视觉证据」的思路，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与有限预算下的信息保留问题有概念联系，但领域为 SNN 持续学习；能否迁移到推理期状态选择尚需核查。
